title: everyday parts, a ninth round: a pillow block, an up-to-next column, a shelled dome, a mirrored bracket, a pin grid, a thickened offset, a rib, a two-distance chamfer

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a pillow block: a 30 × 30 × 22 housing on a 60 × 30 × 8 plate, a bore (radius 8) through it along y at z = 20, the bore's edges chamfered 1 at 30°, mounting holes (radius 3) at (7, 15) and (53, 15)

cases.name: c002
cases.description: a C frame (a 40 × 40 base 5 thick, a wall 5 thick up its x = 0 side to z = 25, a top 5 thick) with a column (radius 4) at (25, 20) extruded from the base up to the next face

cases.name: c003
cases.description: a dome: a quarter circle (radius 20) closed to the axis revolved, shelled 1.5 open at its bottom, a hole (radius 3) through its top

cases.name: c004
cases.description: a bracket (a 30 × 20 × 5 foot, a 5 thick wall 20 up its x = 25 end, a hole of radius 3 through the wall) mirrored across x = 0 and united with its mirror

cases.name: c005
cases.description: a 40 × 30 × 5 plate with a pin (radius 2, 7 tall) at (8, 8) patterned as a part 3 along x at 12 and 2 along y at 14, all united

cases.name: c006
cases.description: a 30 × 20 × 10 block with its top offset 5 up as a surface, the surface thickened 2 up into a plate of its own

cases.name: c007
cases.description: a channel (a 40 × 30 × 4 base, walls 3 thick and 16 tall along y = 0 and y = 30) with a rib (3 thick) across it at x = 20, sketched on its top and extruded down to the base

cases.name: c008
cases.description: a 30 × 20 × 10 block with its top front edge chamfered 2 and 4 and its top back edge filleted 3
